prediction_time: Actual customer delivery, before first review
timestamp_policy: Naive Olist timestamps consistently compared as supplied; fractional days = seconds / 86400; no date truncation
review_policy: Review creation time used only for temporal validation; review fields never predictors

delivery_duration_days.missing_policy: Missing if either timestamp is missing

delivery_delay_days.missing_policy: Missing if either timestamp is missing; early delivery stays negative

late_delivery.missing_policy: Missing if either timestamp is missing

freight_ratio.missing_policy: Missing for missing/nonpositive price or missing freight

invalid_price.formula: 1 if total_price is missing or <= 0 else 0

same_state_share.formula: same-state item rows / item rows with both seller and customer state available
same_state_share.missing_policy: Missing when no item rows have both states
